title: Q-UIUX-boundary-backend-detail: front-end boundary: backend-detail
body:
**Owner:** uiux-manager
**Trigger:** the UI/UX audit found `backend-detail` (boundary) on 2 page view(s)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation uiux --probe boundary-backend-detail
**Status:** open

UIUX-1 finding. "ops/transparency.json" is visible to users

Pages: numbers-board.ultrastable.app/ (desktop), numbers-board.ultrastable.app/ (phone)

Fix the page or the shared component that renders it (site/ and the design tokens), keep the single-primary-action, 44px tap, AA contrast and plain-language rules, and never relax doctrine/uiux.json to clear the finding. Re-run `node scripts/uiux_audit.mjs --only <path>` to confirm.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation uiux --probe boundary-backend-detail` exits 0 (the finding no longer reproduces).
